text: Model-based yes/no gate (Jev-style): add when an open-source variant runs locally, or after two logged incidents the plain checks missed
Dispatch helper: one command that creates the dev-based worktree, the handshake stub and the filled builder brief for a task
Stop zip merge conflicts: builders' branches always conflict on the committed zips; consider a merge driver or building zips only at release commits
Maturation pass before v0.3.1: the gate is now a large static shell reader and the suite more than doubled; prune and simplify using alpha usage evidence before adding anything
Hard layer under the gate: evaluate Claude Code sandbox / permission deny rules for the protected tree, since the gate's evasion resistance is not independently verified
Ship Fableous as a Claude Code plugin (marketplace in this repo) once the mode has settled
Secret scan on every file write (post-write hook), if the ritual-time check keeps finding real cases
Analysis engine: explicit consent line and redaction before record text goes to a remote endpoint
Generator freshness should compare output hashes too, so a hand-edited derived file is detected
statectl accept should remove the task's stub after a successful merge (T10, T12, T13 stubs were left behind)
Build exit check: run each distinct Test command once and skip commands that are subsets of a full-suite command already run; today 13 tasks mean 12 reruns and more than 10 minutes

/adhd branch model: upstream pins no model (branches and critic inherit the session model; its evals used one model). Our branch_model=sonnet is our own untested choice: compare sonnet vs inherit on 3 real questions during alpha testing, then fix UPSTREAM.md, which reads as if Sonnet were upstream's default
Citable release: CITATION.cff plus Zenodo GitHub integration at the stable 0.3 tag (concept DOI), and a written system report (docs/system-report.md) describing the design of record for the archive

Surgically trim .claude/CLAUDE.md toward the ~80-line folder-health target: keep it a map (pointers to protocols, reference, STATUS), move explanations into the files they point at, keep the two role sections short; verify with mapctl context and the context_health check

Code graph in the console: a CODE tab (file/class/function/config nodes; contains/imports/calls edges) for the whole repo plus a per-scope view (src/ or .claude/tools), inline force layout, click-to-source via snippet in the payload plus an editor link; fed by graphctl.py build (graphify --code-only through uvx when present, stdlib ast fallback otherwise), registered as generator code_graph_build, output .claude/system-map/code-graph.json gitignored and served live only. Design: .claude/research/2026-11-04-code-graph-console.md. Never run graphify install (third-party PreToolUse hook in the protected tree).

CREDITS.md at the repo root (shipped in kits too): name the tools, projects and sources this system was built with or borrowed from, with link, licence and what was taken. Known entries today: Claude Code and the Anthropic docs (the host); UditAkhourii/adhd (MIT) for the /adhd skill (NOTICE already carries the legal line; CREDITS carries the thanks and what changed, pointing at skills/adhd/UPSTREAM.md); sdamirsa/cview (the worker/review model the 0.3 backbone was shaped for); Graphify-Labs/graphify and tree-sitter (the code graph extractor, once PR-15 lands); actions/checkout (the only workflow action); Zenodo (archival, once PR-13 lands); the two private source systems of 2026-08 named only by role (never by path or content). Also resolve what 'Jev' in issue #12 refers to and credit it if an idea was taken. NOTICE stays the legal file; CREDITS is lineage and thanks. A test asserts every CREDITS entry has a URL and a licence word.

note: Maintainer direction on record (memory: no marketplace plugin, Apache-2.0 kits via distctl export). Revisit only if a plugin becomes the sole way to ship hooks.
